vibe_rationale: Community-trusted, curated First Nations music and culture day with a sold-out track record, though single-day and music-led rather than multi-format.
fit_notes: Strong cultural purpose and community trust, but the audience is all-ages with no adult skew recorded, and any health role would need to be First Nations-led, consulted and long-term rather than a logo. Brisbane City Council already sponsors and there is no public partnerships contact.
